newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Sierra Leone central bank damaged in coup fighting.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Leone central bank damaged in coup fighting.

text.p: Sierra Leone's central bank suffered fire damage in Sunday's military coup and quantities of documents have been lost, witnesses said on Monday.
Fire spread from the adjacent Treasury building, which was badly damaged in the fighting for control of the presidential offices nearby at State House.

The local Union Trust Bank was looted, and private exchange bureaus were broken into. Freetown residents stayed away from work on Monday despite appeals from the new military rulers for them to resume their normal activities.
With random shooting still going on, officials were not immediately able to assess the extent of the damage.
